entries.name: grill-tab
entries.description: Press Tab in the Desktop composer to grill a draft before it becomes a session: a fast auxiliary model asks one high-leverage decision at a time (with a recommended answer), then Enter synthesizes a faithful execution brief into the composer for review. Works for research, writing, planning, ops, design, and code; never auto-sends.

entries.name: herdr-auto-reconcile
entries.description: Wake Hermes when allowlisted Herdr panes need reconciliation, without routing or controlling pane work.

entries.name: hermes-auto-titler
entries.description: Provenance-aware automatic session title maintenance that never overrides user titles.

entries.name: hermes-ledgerline
entries.description: Inspect session costs and usage in Hermes Desktop.

entries.name: hermes-live-voice
entries.description: Full-duplex Live Voice for Hermes Desktop — GPT-Live-1 on the ChatGPT/Codex subscription via the local Codex app-server, with live transcript, voice tool calls and task delegation to the user chat.

entries.name: hermes-memory-wiki
entries.description: Memory Wiki dashboard tab: browsable subject pages and daily logs derived from local session history, plus a read-only Persistent Memory (MEMORY.md / USER.md) audit panel.

entries.name: hermes-newswire
entries.description: Breaking-news ticker for Hermes Desktop: a scrolling RSS/Atom/JSON-Feed strip above the statusbar with per-source favicons, feed search + discovery, grouping modes, offline cache, and in-app reading. Zero API keys, zero model tokens.

entries.name: hermes-nous-prices
entries.description: Browse Nous Portal model prices and account balances in Hermes Desktop.

entries.name: hermes-office
entries.description: View and manage Bot Mode agents in a shared office in Hermes Desktop.

entries.name: hermes-pets-all
entries.description: Browse every pet installed for this Hermes profile in its own desktop pane (thumbnails, search, click-to-adopt), plus a read-only list_pets tool for the agent.

entries.name: hermes-plugin-chrome-profiles
entries.description: Switch Hermes browser tools between local and remote Chrome/Edge profiles via CDP.

entries.name: hermes-plugin-netbox
entries.description: NetBox change management: query DCIM/IPAM objects, build a reviewed field-level diff, apply with a journal and roll back.

entries.name: hermes-resetwatch
entries.description: Track subscription quotas and reset times in Hermes Desktop.

entries.name: hermes-rss
entries.description: Read RSS and Atom feeds and discuss articles in Hermes Desktop.

entries.name: hermes-rustpush-imessage
entries.description: Local-only iMessage platform plugin backed by a launchd-supervised OpenBubbles RustPush sidecar over a same-user Unix socket.

entries.name: hermes-snapcompact
entries.description: Snapcompact context engine: archives conversation history as dense bitmap PNG frames that vision models read back at ~1/3 the token cost.

entries.name: hermes-ssh
entries.description: Manage SSH connections and remote workspaces in Hermes Desktop.

entries.name: hermes-tailscale
entries.description: Browse Tailscale devices and connect to remote Hermes instances in Hermes Desktop.

entries.name: hermes-telegram-business
entries.description: Observe-with-approval Telegram Business Mode (secretary bot): every drafted customer reply needs owner approval before it is sent.

entries.name: hermes-terminal
entries.description: Run the Hermes terminal interface in a Hermes Desktop workspace tab.

entries.name: jackal-verified
entries.description: Typed adapter for the reproducible JACKAL v1.7.3 release: 41 catalog-derived verification tools (exact, numerical, Lean-checked bounded lanes, claim replay).

entries.name: metamask-wallet
entries.description: MetaMask Agent Wallet for Hermes — chat-only setup, reads, and approval-gated transfers/swaps/signatures, a gated Guard Mode policy editor, and a background 2FA watcher. Keys stay in MetaMask.

entries.name: shodan
entries.description: Shodan tools with complete capability declarations.

entries.name: snyk
entries.description: Scan code (SAST), dependencies, container images, IaC and SBOMs with Snyk through its first-party MCP server (pinned snyk@1.1306.0 over npx stdio, CLI analytics disabled), with the snyk-security-scan workflow skill bundled. Portable Agent Plugins v1 package (mcp.json + skills/); needs Node.js/npm on PATH and a free Snyk account (browser login via the snyk_auth tool).

entries.name: touchdesigner
entries.description: Drive a live TouchDesigner session through the twozero MCP server (Streamable HTTP on 127.0.0.1:40404), with the touchdesigner-mcp workflow skill bundled. Portable Agent Plugins v1 package (mcp.json + skills/); TouchDesigner itself runs on macOS/Windows.

entries.name: web-octen
entries.description: Octen web search with query-focused highlights and page extraction.
